stream:assistant.handled: claude/session.ts: model, usage, main-loop wake-up (text comes from the transcript)

stream:user.ignored: the stream echo of a message; the transcript carries user records and tool results

stream:result/success.handled: claude/session.ts: result → turn boundary, reply, usage, cost

stream:result/error_during_execution.generic: every result subtype takes the same path; the outcome is mapped from is_error and the subtype

stream:result/error_max_turns.generic: every result subtype takes the same path; the outcome is mapped from is_error and the subtype

stream:result/error_max_budget_usd.generic: every result subtype takes the same path; the outcome is mapped from is_error and the subtype

stream:result/error_max_structured_outpu.generic: every result subtype takes the same path; the outcome is mapped from is_error and the subtype

stream:system/init.handled: claude/session.ts: model adoption and the init line

stream:system/status.ignored: transient CLI status (e.g. "requesting"); turn state comes from frames that carry facts

stream:system/api_retry.handled: claude/session.ts: system/api_retry event with attempt, delay and status

stream:system/compact_boundary.handled: claude/transcripts.ts: the transcript record of the same compaction (describeSystem, with token details)

stream:system/task_started.handled: claude/session.ts: subagent card (live), background-task guard for recycling; a resumed agent (SendMessage to a stopped one) arrives as task_started under the SendMessage call and becomes a new run card of the turn that sent it

stream:system/task_progress.handled: claude/session.ts: provisional subagent metrics, keyed by the run's call (tool_use_id), so a resumed run reports on its own card

stream:system/task_notification.generic: the transcript record of the same notice is what is parsed (the tag is <task-notification>)

stream:system/task_updated.ignored: progress bookkeeping; ends arrive as task notifications and results

stream:system/background_tasks_changed.ignored: a count of background tasks; each task is tracked from task_started to its notification

stream:system/hook_started.ignored: hook progress; the transcript stop_hook_summary carries what changed the turn

stream:system/local_command_output.generic: the transcript local_command record carries the same output

stream:system/session_state_changed.ignored: the CLI announcing its own state; the ledger derives turn state from results and actors

stream:system/commands_changed.ignored: slash-command catalog is read from disk (harnesses/skills.ts)

stream:system/control_request_progress.ignored: progress of a control request the driver already answered

stream:system/elicitation_complete.ignored: elicitations are answered as control requests

stream:system/files_persisted.ignored: file checkpointing bookkeeping; edits are shown from tool results

stream:system/informational.ignored: CLI chatter with no turn or timeline meaning (yet); recorded if seen with a new shape

stream:system/memory_recall.ignored: memory retrieval notice; no timeline counterpart yet

stream:system/mirror_error.ignored: session-mirroring error internal to the CLI

stream:system/model_refusal_fallback.ignored: the model the CLI fell back to is adopted from the next assistant frame

stream:system/model_refusal_no_fallback.ignored: the refusal ends the turn with a failed result, which is handled

stream:system/permission_denied.ignored: permissions are decided by the driver (control_request can_use_tool)

stream:system/worker_shutting_down.ignored: process exit is detected by the liveness check (processExited)

stream:tool_progress.ignored: elapsed-time ticks for a running tool

stream:tool_use_summary.ignored: a model-written summary of tool calls the transcript already shows

stream:auth_status.ignored: login state; a signed-out CLI fails its turn with a readable error

stream:conversation_reset.ignored: a /clear inside the CLI; sedano starts a new session instead
